programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: A client wants to give his modern home a classic log-cabin look; the guys build a facade using antique log veneers; they use more log veneers to create a piece for the showroom; Mark tours a home that's fully decked out in reclaimed wood veneers.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.desc: In Ohio, the builders dismantle the largest log home they've ever seen, and they discover it's filled with history, craftsmanship and cherished memories; Mark gives the cabin owner tips on how to convert her family's old barn into a modern home.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Peeling Layers off a Covered Log Home in Virginia
programs.desc: In Abingon, Va., the guys take down a farmhouse that Mark bought sight unseen; they strip away each layer and salvage the hand-hewn timbers underneath.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Turning a Ramshackle Cabin Into a Guest House in Missouri
programs.desc: The guys travel to Missouri to take down and rebuild a historic 170-year-old cabin, converting it into a guest house.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Raising a Massive Timber Frame Barn in Downtown Lewisburg
programs.desc: In Lewisburg, Mark and the guys raise a massive timber frame as the new shelter for the city's farmer's market.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Building a Log Chapel With a Stained Glass Window
programs.desc: Mark and the guys head to Johnny Jett's hometown in Kentucky to build a log chapel; they reclaim a stained-glass window from a deteriorating 100-year-old church, then they build the chapel and install the window.
